title: Temple of Chaos 2 - Warped Reality
description: Temple of Chaos 2 - Warped Reality is a single-level map set in a warped reality resembling the Phobos UAC base. The level features Doom 2 Map07-style gameplay requiring players to kill monsters to proceed, custom music, and three custom enemies including the Plasma zombie, BFG zombie, and Hectebus.
